<a id="page-decoration"></a>
# Decoration

Fills, gradients, borders, corners, shadows, blurs, clipping and pictures. Open it when a box needs more than
`fill`, `border` and `radius`.

<a id="decoration-fills-borders-and-corners"></a>
## Fills, borders and corners

`fill` is one color; `gradient=["#FF2563EB","#FF7C3AED"]` a linear gradient with even stops; `fills=[…]` any list
of paints ([Paint](#type-Paint): colors, gradients, images, noise). `border` is a hairline, `strokeWidth` its
width, `border-bottom` one side (bound too: `border-bottom={active ? accent : transparent}`); `radius` one number or `[topLeft,topRight,bottomRight,bottomLeft]`.

```notation
Column gap=8
  Column w=120 h=80 gradient=["#FF2563EB","#FF7C3AED"]
  Column w=120 h=80 border=#FFE5E7EB strokeWidth=2 radius=12
  Column w=48 h=48 fill=#FF2563EB shape=circle
```

Shadows and blurs are `effects=[…]` ([Effect](#type-Effect)); `clip=true` clips the content to the corners.

```notation
Column w=120 h=80 fill=#FFFFFFFF effects=[{"type":"dropShadow","color":"#33000000","offset":[0,4],"blurRadius":16}]
```

<a id="decoration-pictures-and-icons"></a>
## Pictures and icons

`Image "url"` is a picture (an image fill on a box; `Image url="…"` and `url={…}` the same); `Icon "name"` a Material
icon.

```notation
Row gap=8
  Image "https://example.com/a.png" w=120 h=80 radius=8
  Icon "star" size=24 color=#FFF59E0B
```

Drawing your own shapes is [paint.md](paint.md).

<a id="decoration-keys-every-decorated-line-takes"></a>
## Keys every decorated line takes

A line takes these where its word is decorated (a Column, Row, Stack, box, Card…); elsewhere only `effects`. The
short words: `fill`, `gradient`, `border`, `radius`.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fills` | list of [Paint](#type-Paint) | `[]` | 0 | Paints for the box, bottom to top: a color, a gradient, an image or noise. |
| `strokes` | list of [Paint](#type-Paint) | `[]` | 0 | Paints for the border, drawn `strokeWidth` wide. |
| `decoration.strokeWidth` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | 0 | The border's width in pixels. Without `strokes` it draws nothing. |
| `strokeAlign` | `inside` `center` `outside` | `inside` | 0 |  |
| `strokeSides` | [StrokeSides](values.md#enum-StrokeSides) | `all` | 0 | Which sides the border is drawn on: `all`, `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, `topBottom`, `leftRight`... |
| `strokeCap` | `butt` `round` `square` | `butt` | 0 |  |
| `dashPattern` | list of number | `[]` | 0 | Dash and gap lengths, alternating; empty is a solid stroke. |
| `radius` | [BorderRadius](values.md#type-BorderRadius) | `0` | 0 |  |
| `effects` | list of [Effect](#type-Effect) | `[]` | 0 | Shadows and blurs: each `{"type": "dropShadow" \| "innerShadow" \| "layerBlur" \| "backgroundBlur", ...}`. |
| `clip` | `none` `hardEdge` `antiAlias` `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` | `none` | 0 | Clips the content to the box (rounded by `radius`). |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `srcOver` | 0 |  |
| `foregroundFills` | list of [Paint](#type-Paint) | `[]` | 0 | Fills painted over the content. |
| `shape` | `rectangle` `circle` | `rectangle` | 0 | A rectangle (rounded by `radius`) or a circle. |

<a id="decoration-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-icon"></a>
### `Icon` (`icon`)

Flutter `Icon`.

- Written `Icon`. Level 0 (Core).
- `Icon "…"` sets `props.icon`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` | 0 | Which glyph: a Material icon name, `"check_circle"` (a style by suffix: `"search_rounded"`), the one form to write everywhere (an icon node, an input's `prefixIcon`). Also read: an image URL, and the object forms of older documents (`{"type": "MATERIAL_ICON", "name", "style"}`, `{"type": "CUPERTINO_ICON", "codepoint"}`). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | 0 | The glyph's color (`"#AARRGGBB"` or a theme color's name). |
| `size` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 | Flutter `Icon.size`: the glyph's width and height. Unset, the glyph fills the node's box (contained, centered), as before. Set, the glyph is drawn at this size, centered in the node's box (at most the box), and a hugging axis of the node takes it (`{"hug": 24}` with `"size": 18` is 18 wide). |

<a id="node-path"></a>
### `Path` (`path`)

Flutter `CustomPaint` of an SVG path.

- Written `Path`. Level 4 (Full vocabulary).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): yes.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | text | `""` | 4 | SVG path data (`M0 0 L10 10 Z`). |
| `viewBox` | [Size](values.md#type-Size) |  | 4 | The coordinate space of `data`, `[width, height]`, scaled to the box. Null: `data` is in the box's own pixels. |
| `scaleStroke` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 4 | Whether the stroke (its width and dash lengths) is in `viewBox` units, scaled with the drawing as in SVG, instead of the box's pixels (an icon's line keeps its weight at any size; a diagram's grows with it). |
| `trimStart` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0` | 4 | The stroked part of the path, as fractions of its length. |
| `trimEnd` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | 4 |  |
| `strokeJoin` | `miter` `round` `bevel` | `miter` | 4 | How segments meet when stroked (`Paint.strokeJoin`). |
| `strokeMiterLimit` | number (≥ 0) | `4` | 4 | The miter limit of `StrokeJoin.miter` corners (`Paint.strokeMiterLimit`). |

<a id="decoration-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-Paint"></a>
### Paint

A fill or stroke paint: a solid color, a gradient or an image. Several paints stack, first at the bottom.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `solid` `linear` `radial` `sweep` `diamond` `image` `noise` | `solid` | What the paint is: `solid` (a color), `linear`, `radial`, `sweep` or `diamond` (a gradient of `stops`), `image`, or `noise`. Without one: an image if it has `image`, a linear gradient if it has `stops`, else solid. |
| `id` | text |  | Stable id, so a binding can target one paint (`fill-<id>`). |
| `visible` | `true`/`false` | `true` | False keeps the paint but does not draw it. |
| `opacity` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `1` | The paint's opacity, 0 to 1, multiplied with its colors' own alpha. |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `srcOver` | How the paint blends with what is under it (CSS `mix-blend-mode`). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Solid color (type `solid`). |
| `stops` | list of [ColorStop](#type-ColorStop) | `[]` | Gradient stops (gradient types). |
| `transform` | list of number |  | Six numbers `[a, b, tx, c, d, ty]` mapping a point (x, y) of the box, in its unit square (0 to 1 each way), into the gradient's unit square: u = a·x + b·y + tx, v = c·x + d·y + ty. A linear gradient runs along u from 0 to 1; `[20, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0]` with `"tileMode": "repeated"` repeats it 20 times across the box. Simpler: `begin`/`end` (linear) or `center`/`radius` (radial). |
| `begin` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | Linear: where the gradient starts, an alignment (`[-1, 0]` or `"centerLeft"`, Flutter `LinearGradient.begin`). Read into `transform`; default the left edge. |
| `end` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | Linear: where the gradient ends (Flutter `LinearGradient.end`). `"begin": [0, -1], "end": [0, 1]` runs top to bottom; `"begin": [-1, 0], "end": [-0.9, 0]` with `"tileMode": "repeated"` repeats it every 5% of the width. |
| `center` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | Radial: its center, an alignment (`[0, -1]`: the middle of the top edge; Flutter `RadialGradient.center`). Read into `transform`; default the box's center. |
| `tileMode` | `clamp` `repeated` `mirror` `decal` | `clamp` | What a gradient does past `begin` and `end`: `clamp` (keeps the end colors), `repeated`, `mirror`, `decal`. |
| `image` | [ImagePaint](#type-ImagePaint) |  | Image (type `image`). |
| `radius` | number (≥ 0) |  | Radial: the radius as a share of the box's shortest side (Flutter's RadialGradient); null: half the box's width (as the transform maps it). Past the last stop the gradient keeps the last stop's color (`tileMode` clamp): end a glow on a transparent stop, or it fills the rest of the box. |
| `length` | number (≥ 0) |  | A gradient's length in logical pixels, whatever the box's size: linear, from `begin` toward `end` (only their direction counts then); radial, its radius. With `"tileMode": "repeated"` the stops repeat every `length` px: CSS `repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #1F2937 0 1px, transparent 1px 80px)` is `{"type": "linear", "begin": "topCenter", "end": "bottomCenter", "length": 80, "tileMode": "repeated", "stops": [{"position": 0, "color": "#FF1F2937"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#FF1F2937"}, {"position": 0.0125, "color": "#00000000"}, {"position": 1, "color": "#00000000"}]}`: a 1 px line every 80 px (a background grid is two such paints). |
| `noise` | [NoisePaint](#type-NoisePaint) |  | Type `noise`: procedural grain, as SVG `<feTurbulence>`: `{"baseFrequency": 0.8, "numOctaves": 3, "seed": 0, "type": "fractalNoise"}`. With `color` the grain is that color, its alpha the noise; without, the four noise channels feTurbulence gives. Fade it with `opacity` (a film grain: 0.05 to 0.12) and set a `blendMode` (`overlay`, `softLight`) as CSS `mix-blend-mode`. Drawn as a seamless 256 px tile repeated over the box. |

<a id="type-ColorStop"></a>
### ColorStop

One gradient stop.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0` | Where the color sits along the gradient, 0 (its start) to 1 (its end). |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#FF000000` | The color at `position`. |

<a id="type-ImagePaint"></a>
### ImagePaint

An image source and how it fills its box (Flutter's `DecorationImage`).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text |  | The image's URL: `https://`, a `data:image/...` URL, or (for the render command's drafts) a path relative to the document. |
| `assetId` | text |  | A project asset's id, for images uploaded to the project. |
| `fit` | `fill` `contain` `cover` `fitWidth` `fitHeight` `none` `scaleDown` | `cover` | How the image fills the box (Flutter's `BoxFit`): `cover`, `contain`, `fill`, `fitWidth`... |
| `alignment` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) | `[0,0]` | Where the image sits in the box when it does not fill it, or which part shows when it is cropped. |
| `repeat` | `noRepeat` `repeat` `repeatX` `repeatY` | `noRepeat` | Whether the image repeats to fill the box (Flutter's `ImageRepeat`). |
| `scale` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | The image's pixel scale (`Image.scale`): 2 draws it at half its size. |
| `tint` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Draws every pixel in this color, keeping its alpha (`ColorFilter.mode(tint, BlendMode.srcIn)`). |
| `flipX` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Mirrors the image horizontally / vertically. |
| `flipY` | `true`/`false` | `false` | Mirrors the image horizontally / vertically. |
| `saturation` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | Color saturation: 1 keeps the colors, 0 is grayscale. |
| `rect` | [Rect](values.md#type-Rect) |  | `[left, top, width, height]`, or null (placed by fit and alignment). |

<a id="type-NoisePaint"></a>
### NoisePaint

A `noise` paint's procedural noise, parameterised as SVG's `<feTurbulence>` (`baseFrequency`, `numOctaves`, `seed`, `type`): the texture a web page's grain overlay draws (`filter: url(#grain)`), here a paint, drawn as a seamless tile repeated over the box.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseFrequency` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 4) | `0.8` | Lattice cells per pixel (feTurbulence `baseFrequency`): 0.8 a fine grain, 0.05 soft clouds. |
| `numOctaves` | whole number (≥ 1) | `3` | Octaves summed, each twice the frequency at half the amplitude. |
| `seed` | whole number | `0` | The random seed: the same seed draws the same grain. |
| `type` | `fractalNoise` `turbulence` | `fractalNoise` | `fractalNoise` (a soft grain) or `turbulence` (ridged). |

<a id="type-Effect"></a>
### Effect

A shadow or blur (Flutter's `BoxShadow`, `ImageFilter.blur`).

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `dropShadow` `innerShadow` `layerBlur` `backgroundBlur` | `dropShadow` | The effect: `dropShadow`, `innerShadow`, `layerBlur` (blurs the node) or `backgroundBlur` (blurs what is behind it: frosted glass). Required: an effect without a type is dropped. |
| `id` | text |  | An id a binding can select the effect by (`decoration.effects.glow.color`). |
| `visible` | `true`/`false` | `true` | False keeps the effect but does not draw it. |
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) | `#40000000` | The shadow's color. |
| `offset` | [Offset](values.md#type-Offset) | `[0,0]` | The shadow's offset `[dx, dy]` in pixels. |
| `blurRadius` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | How soft the shadow or blur is, in pixels. |
| `spreadRadius` | number | `0` | How far the shadow grows past the box before blurring, in pixels. |
| `blendMode` | [BlendMode](values.md#enum-BlendMode) | `srcOver` | How the effect blends with what is under it. |

<a id="type-BorderSide"></a>
### BorderSide

Flutter's `BorderSide`. A null `color` is unset: the widget's theme default where it has one, else Flutter's black.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | The line's color. |
| `width` | number (≥ 0) | `1` | The line's width in pixels. |
| `style` | `none` `solid` | `solid` | `solid` or `none`. |
| `strokeAlign` | `inside` `center` `outside` | `inside` | Where the line sits on the edge: inside, centered on it, or outside. |

<a id="decoration-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="decoration-example-photo-card-json"></a>
### photo_card.json

From [`photo_card.json`](../decoration.md).

```notation
canvas h=320
Column#page pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":320} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Column#card gap=6 end pad=20 w={"fill":342} layout.height=240 fills=[{"type":"image","image":{"url":"assets/photo.png","fit":"cover","alignment":[0,-0.3]}},{"type":"linear","begin":[0,-1],"end":[0,1],"stops":[{"color":"#00000000","position":0.35},{"color":"#CC000000","position":1}]}] radius=16 clip=antiAlias
    Text.small#kicker "TRAVEL" weight=700 color=#FFFDE68A letterSpacing=2 w={"fill":302} h={"hug":16}
    Text.title#headline "A week on the salt marsh, by boat and on foot" weight=700 color=#FFFFFFFF lineHeight=1.3 w={"fill":302} h={"hug":56}
```

<a id="decoration-example-paint-illustration-json"></a>
### paint_illustration.json

From [`paint_illustration.json`](../decoration.md).

```notation
canvas h=260
Column#page pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":260} crossAxisAlignment=null
  box#scene w={"fill":342} h=212
    customPaint viewBox=[320,200] fit=cover
      rect rect=[0,0,320,200] fill=#FFE8F1F8
      circle c=[236,62] radius=28 fill=#FFF4B740
      repeat count=3
        circle c=[{60 + index * 34},{48 + index * 6}] radius=3 fill=#FF5D6D7E
      path d="M0 150 C60 100 120 110 170 140 C220 170 270 120 320 130 L320 200 L0 200 Z" fill=#FF7FB685
      path d="M0 170 C80 140 160 160 220 175 C260 185 290 170 320 165 L320 200 L0 200 Z" fill=#FF3E7C59
      line p1=[40,196] p2=[280,196] stroke=#33FFFFFF strokeWidth=2
```
